response.text:
The finding covers invoice 757 only. Its invoice amount is 6,622.24. Journal 2245 debits 5300 for 6,631.24 and credits 2000 for 6,622.24, so the journal is unbalanced by 9.00 on the debit side.

The AP credit already ties to the invoice, so the debit expense line is the one that is overstated by 9.00. The correction is a single credit of 9.00 to 5300, which brings the net 5300 debit to 6,622.24 and balances the group. Posting it to period 11, which is open, keeps the correction small and avoids the closed period 8. No invoice status changes are made, because this is not a duplicate_invoice finding.

arguments.reasoning: Invoice 757 is 6,622.24 and journal 2245 credits AP 6,622.24, but it debits expense 5300 for 6,631.24, so the journal is out of balance by 9.00 on the debit side. A one-sided credit of 9.00 to 5300 in open period 11 brings the net expense to 6,622.24 and balances the journal group. No status changes, and the other invoices (222, 743) are outside this finding.
